author: John Hammond
description:
This clip breaks down how malware and threat actors can disable Microsoft SmartScreen by modifying Windows registry settings.

The commands are loud, obvious, and should be generating alerts in a healthy security environment. We walk through the registry changes, user privileges involved, and why your EDR should be paying attention.

Watch the full video: https://youtu.be/p6ySQ94GZsA?si=pKqAdKX9IB6i5fD6
title: Disable SmartScreen Fast
